panel.title: Who will do it?
panel.subtitle: Choose your own team or invite an outside provider for this job.

team.title: My team
team.unavailable: This job can no longer be assigned.

network.title: AgroRende network
network.body: Find rated providers near you. The directory arrives in the next phase.

external.title: Invite from outside
external.body: Send a link by WhatsApp or email. No account needed for the provider.
external.blocked: There is already an active invite for this job. Revoke it to invite someone else.
external.closed: Closed or cancelled jobs cannot receive new invites.

form.title: Invite an outside provider
form.name: Provider name
form.phoneHint: With area code, digits only. Example: 64 99999-0000
form.contactHint: Fill in WhatsApp, email or both.
form.messagePlaceholder: Example: tractor stopped on the north field, can you come tomorrow?

errors.contactRequired: Enter a WhatsApp number or an email.
errors.phoneInvalid: Enter 10 to 15 digits, with area code.

share.title: Invite link ready
share.body: The link works for 7 days and only shows this job. Anyone with the link can answer, so send it only to the provider.
share.emailQueued: We also queued the invite email.
share.whatsappText: Hello {name}, you are invited to a job on AgroRende: {title}. Open the link to accept, decline or propose a price: {url}
share.whatsappTextWithMessage: Hello {name}, you are invited to a job on AgroRende: {title}. {message} Open the link to accept, decline or propose a price: {url}
share.emailBody:
Hello {name},

you are invited to a job: {title}.

Open the link to accept, decline or propose a price:
{url}

The link expires in 7 days.

invite.title: External provider
invite.reissueConfirmBody: The previous link stops working right away. Send the new one to the provider.
invite.revokeConfirmBody: The provider will no longer be able to open the link. You can invite someone else afterwards.

completion.title: Provider marked the job as done

agreement.title: Agreed value
agreement.notice: Payment happens outside AgroRende. We only record what was agreed and who confirmed it.
agreement.locked: The agreement is locked because a payment was already confirmed.

payment.title: Paid outside the platform
payment.needsAgreement: Set the agreed value before confirming the payment.

review.title: Review
review.awaitingProvider: Waiting for the provider reply. You will be able to answer once.
review.onlyCompleted: You can review once the provider marks the job as done.

link.title: Job invite
link.noLogin: No account needed. Only you received this link.
link.counterRequired: Enter a price, a date or both.

answered.ACCEPTED: You accepted this job. When you finish, mark it as done here.
answered.DECLINED: You declined this job. Thank you for answering.
answered.COUNTERED: Your proposal was sent. The company will answer soon.

cta.title: Get more jobs like this
cta.body: Create your free provider profile on AgroRende. The first 60 days are free.

recovery.title: This link no longer works
recovery.invalid: We could not find this invite. Check that you opened the full link.
recovery.expired: This invite expired. Invites are valid for 7 days.
recovery.next: Ask the company that invited you for a new link.

toast.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.
